{{Disambig|Mutated}}

==Enemies==
'''Mutated''' may refer to these enemies:
*[[Mutagenic Blight]], an enemy that first appears on Wave 17
*[[Wastewalker|Mutated Wastewalker]], an enemy that first appears on Wave 1
*[[Wasterunner|Mutated Speedy]], a quick enemy that first appears on Wave 1
*[[Super Mutant]], an enemy that first appears on Wave 5

==Other==
'''Mutated''' may also refer to:
*[[Mutation]], a gameplay modifier that increases the shield health of enemies
